caption:
The private office.

Walnut panels that wrap the room, cream walls with fine joints, a walnut and black desk in front of the window, a wall of four screens above a floating unit, and a lounge corner with two armchairs and stone-backed shelving that can be lit.

Interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
